mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, WRITER_NO, CATEGORY_ID, TRADE_TYPE, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, PRICE, PRODUCT_CONDITION, AUCTION_START_PRICE, AUCTION_END_TIME, IS_DIRECT, TRADE_LOCATION, STATUS, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, IS_DELETED, TO_CHAR(AUCTION_END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS AUCTION_END_TIME_STR, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT_STR, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT_STR FROM PRODUCTS WHERE product_id = #{productId}
